# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, dying several years later.  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking person with an ungainly, stooping figure and long iron-gray hair that touched his shoulders. He had worn a full, soft brown beard continuously since he was twenty years old. He looked virtually the same at age sixty as he had at twenty, with only a little extra grayness.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Extremely shy, quiet, and reserved, Matthew hated going among strangers or speaking in public, and he stood in dread of women and girls with the exception of his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his bashfulness, he possessed a gentle, sympathetic nature and a quiet, stubborn persistency when he set his mind on something. He enjoyed talkative companions who did not expect him to converse, and he formed a deep, affectionate bond with Anne Shirley, frequently encouraging and indulging her.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## Goals

- Keep Anne at Green Gables and provide her with a good life and education  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his unmarried sister, Marilla. Intending to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farmwork, Matthew drove to Bright River station only to find eleven-year-old Anne Shirley waiting instead. Touched by her chatter and imaginative spirit during the drive home, Matthew quietly insisted to Marilla that they keep her. Over the following years, he became Anne's steadfast supporter, giving her a gift of a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas and encouraging her academic pursuits. As he aged, he suffered from severe heart trouble and worked beyond his physical capacity. After learning of the sudden failure of the Abbey Bank where all his savings were deposited, Matthew collapsed and died instantly of the shock. He was buried in the Avonlea graveyard, where Anne continued to visit his grave long after his passing.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_
